recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration clarify the role of the United Nations Office at Geneva in accounting and submission of financial reporting data for entities that are part of volume I and for those entities for which the Office serves only as a service provider. The Board suggests that the Administration create clear structures and responsibilities and formally document them.
